snippet.title: The Necromancer's Tale | Console Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now!
PS5 https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10018315
Xbox https://www.xbox.com/en-GB/games/store/the-necromancers-tale/9NB27CPGJL5Q/0010
Switch 2 https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-2-games/The-Necromancer-s-Tale-3100107.html

Necromancer's Tale is a story-rich gothic RPG. Master the rituals of an ancient spellbook. Raise an undead army to march against your enemies. Commune with the realm of the dead & struggle with your descent into madness. Progress through secrecy, diplomacy, blackmail, coercion & seduction until ready to reveal yourself.
